summary: First-pass testing of Uttarkashi Taxi Union skeleton. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (trips list/filter/get, booking create/reject-taken/list/get/confirm, driver/all). Frontend: Home (Book a Seat heading, Aarav Sharma, 4 route chips, Uttarkashi→Dehradun trip cards with seat counts, ₹450/500) renders correctly. Route chip Uttarkashi→Rishikesh switches trip list. Trip tap opens seat picker with 7-seat SUV layout (driver seat 1 disabled, seats 2-7 selectable, booked seats disabled, total updates). Book Now creates booking, navigates to ticket screen with black card and UTK- booking ref. My Bookings tab shows new PENDING booking. Profile shows user info + Driver Portal button. Driver page lists all trips with pending/confirmed counts, expand shows passenger bookings, Confirm button changes status to confirmed (verified via backend statuses).

issues: Shows raw backend seat numbers (e.g., 'Seat 3') while Ticket and Driver screens show display seat numbers (e.g., 'Seat 4'). Inconsistent seat numbering between screens — My Bookings should display +1 (display seat = backend seat + 1) to stay consistent with the 7-seat SUV layout.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (non-blocking, RN web compat)

action_items: Fix seat number display inconsistency on My Bookings screen: map backend seat_numbers (1-6) to display seats (2-7) like ticket.tsx and driver.tsx do (low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan context manager.

Booking creation is not atomic — race condition possible: two simultaneous POST /api/bookings for the same seat could both pass the 'already booked' check before $set updates. Consider $addToSet with filter on booked_seats or a transaction.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is permissive (acceptable for demo, flag for prod).
server.py uses Pydantic .dict() (deprecated in Pydantic v2; use .model_dump()).
seed_data_creation: Two bookings created via UI+tests for +91 98765 00001 on the 08:00 AM Uttarkashi→Rishikesh trip (one confirmed via driver portal, one may remain). Prefixed one via API as TEST_Aarav Sharma.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. All 8 required endpoints working. Demo user hardcoded. Seat mapping: backend 1-6 ↔ display 2-7 (only ticket.tsx and driver.tsx currently apply the offset; bookings.tsx does not).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features pass. Minor seat-number display mismatch on My Bookings noted for polish.
